Advanced Analytical Testing for Biologics Development

Delivering the data, insights and analytical expertise needed to advance biologic therapies with confidence

SmaBio Labs provides comprehensive analytical testing and characterization services to support biologics throughout development. Our scientists work as an extension of our partners' teams, helping evaluate critical quality attributes, assess product consistency, and generate reliable data for successful BLA submissions. By combining deep technical expertise with a collaborative approach, we help biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies overcome complex analytical challenges and move promising therapies closer to patients.

A  ADC Analytical Testing Capabilities

A1

End-to-End ADC Characterization

DAR · UV · HIC · LC-MS

  • Antibody, linker, payload, and conjugate-level testing
  • DAR determination (UV, HIC, LC-MS)
  • Conjugation site and distribution analysis
A2

Advanced Separation & Detection

HIC · SEC · IEX · RP-HPLC

  • HIC, SEC, IEX, RP-HPLC
  • Intact mass and subunit LC-MS
  • Peptide mapping and payload-related impurity profiling
A3

Potency, Release & Stability Testing

ICH conditions · to −80 °C

  • In vitro drug release (free payload, linker cleavage)
  • Stability Studies under ICH conditions, including low temperatures (-20C to -80C)
A4

Bioanalytical & Safety-Relevant Assays

  • Free vs. conjugated drug quantification
  • Aggregation, fragmentation, and charge variant analysis
  • Residual solvents, elemental impurities, and extractables support

B  Protein & Polypeptide Analytical Testing Capabilities

B1

Structural & Physicochemical Characterization

LC-MS · CD · FTIR · DSC

  • Molecular weight confirmation (intact, reduced, subunit LC-MS)
  • Primary structure and sequence confirmation (peptide mapping)
  • Higher-order structure assessment (CD, FTIR, DSC)
B2

Purity, Heterogeneity & Impurity Profiling

SEC · SDS-PAGE · CE-SDS · IEX

  • Aggregates and fragments (SEC, SDS-PAGE, CE-SDS)
  • Charge variants (IEX)
  • Oxidation, deamidation, truncation, and related impurities
B3

Polypeptide Testing

RP-HPLC · LC-MS

  • Peptide identity and content (RP-HPLC, LC-MS)
  • Related substances
  • Residual solvents
B4

Potency & Functional Assays

  • Binding and activity assays (cell-based or biochemical)
  • Enzymatic activity and receptor interaction testing
